# Superior Home Builders

Custom home builder and general contractor in Mount Vernon, Oregon specializing in custom home building, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, and commercial construction across Grant County and Eastern Oregon.

## Business Information
- Phone: (541) 620-0340
- Address: Mount Vernon, OR 97865
- Service Area: Mount Vernon, John Day, Canyon City, Prairie City, Dayville, Long Creek, Monument, Seneca (Grant County); Burns, Hines (Harney County); and the greater Eastern Oregon region
- Licensed: Yes — Oregon Construction Contractors Board CCB# 147123
- Insured: Yes — general liability insurance
- Founded: 2001
- Estimates: Free, no-obligation estimates on all projects

## About
Superior Home Builders is a licensed and insured general contractor based in Mount Vernon, Oregon, serving Grant County, Harney County, and Eastern Oregon for over 25 years. The company builds custom homes — including off-grid homes on rural land — and handles remodeling, framing, decks, window and door installation, commercial construction, metal roofing, pole barns, gutters, excavation, siding, fencing, painting, insulation, electrical/plumbing/HVAC, garages, and storm damage repair. Service areas include Mount Vernon, John Day, Canyon City, Prairie City, Dayville, Long Creek, Monument, Seneca, Burns, and Hines. We are licensed to work throughout the state of Oregon (CCB# 147123). All projects start with a free on-site estimate and a written, itemized proposal.
